# Theme: Mofka as a Foundation for Workflow Provenance

**⚠ DRAFT** — this synthesis has not yet been human-confirmed. Present it to the human and run `wake theme confirm` on their behalf once they approve it (requires every cited work below to be individually human-verified first).

## Summary

Mofka's persistent event-streaming model provides the infrastructure for HPC workflow provenance systems, enabling capture of data movement and computational events that can be queried and audited. Provenance-focused systems reference Mofka as a candidate broker for provenance message transport in tightly coupled HPC environments.
